messages:
Maya Patel: RCA published for last night's degraded routing incident: https://redwood.atlassian.com/RCA-2187. Short summary: fallback routing misconfiguration + aggressive cache eviction pattern caused intermittent 5xxs for some customers. Action items listed with owners.

Ravi Singh: Link works. Quick read: I can take the routing config rollback and add validation to the deploy pipeline. Targeting rollback + tests by Mon EOD.

Li Wei: I will own the cache eviction mitigation: add a conservative TTL and telemetry to detect abnormal eviction spikes. Will open PR and request eng-runtime review.

Oncall Bot: Incident snapshot: error-rate spike to 2.3% for 12m, p99 latency increased from 650ms to 1.2s at peak. Affected customers: 7 orgs. No data loss.

Maya Patel: Thanks — I updated the RCA with owners and set a 7-day follow-up. Please add status notes into the doc and react with :white_check_mark: when you acknowledge your task.

Ravi Singh: Ack :white_check_mark: — rolling back config and adding CI guard rails.

Li Wei: Ack :white_check_mark: — will post PR and canary plan in the RCA.

Maya Patel: Will run the 7-day check-in next Thu 09:00 PST. Invite sent. If you cant make it, leave an update in the doc. Thanks everyone.
